_huong_dan: Cach doc rieng cho giong OmniVoice: tu nao doc sai thi them vao day, chi giong doc thay, phu de giu nguyen. "*" = moi ngon ngu; ma ngon ngu ("de", "ja"...) = rieng ngon ngu do (ghi de len "*"). Thay nguyen tu, phan biet hoa thuong, cum dai khop truoc. Cau nao doc sai xem trong logs/qc-<ma>.txt (Whisper nghe lai). Sua xong chay lai: cau co tu do se duoc doc lai.
